script_text: Taurus, this week your Venus-ruled earth nature meets a money shock. Monday, Venus conjuncts Uranus in your 2nd House while 8th House Moon opposes Venus, shaking pricing or debt. Tuesday steadies with Sun trine Mars in your 12th House, then Wednesday's Mercury-Uranus conjunction favors invoices or a rate raise. The turn comes June 21, when Sun and Venus enter Cancer, 3rd House, shifting luck to calls and contracts. Friday, the Moon in your 10th trines Uranus in the 2nd, spotlighting career income. Venus in Cancer trines Saturn in 11th House, steadying friendships and plans. Weekend warning: Sunday's Moon conjuncts Saturn in your 11th, so networks need patience. Sunday is worst: Venus squares Neptune in 3rd and 12th, so avoid vague romance or work terms. Best day: Wednesday, for a clear money breakthrough. Weekly advice: write numbers before Venus makes you impulsive. Follow for daily updates.
